claims.text: A verdict under Spec 035 states only whether the registered criterion for PRED-2026-010 is met.
boundary: Scope claim for the whole spec. The registered prediction (docs/PREDICTION_REGISTER.md, PRED-2026-010) is the input, not a question; a verdict is a statement about the registered criterion on the registered data. It does not govern the step-0 checks (C04-C06, C09), the computation (C10-C11), or the register handling (C14). What the signs mean, why they pattern as they do, and stability at any other site are never judged under this spec.
alternatives: A scored prediction may be read as evidence about the script's decipherment or about sign meanings.
falsification_tests: Any Spec 035 outcome statement claiming more than the registered criterion's outcome on the registered data defeats this claim.
